page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.r7 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. It is provisioned with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor, ensuring secure and isolated execution environments for enterprise workloads.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the ecs.r7.16xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory capacity without proportional increases in compute cores. This resource profile is suited for memory-intensive applications such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
